subject: Your 800 neighbors know something you don't
preview_text: The quiet truth about what happens when you don't trust your gut—and how 800 users changed their story.
body_paragraphs: You know that feeling when your stomach knots up but your brain tries to talk you out of it? That's the moment most of us ignore. And it's the moment that changes everything.

I've watched 800 people walk through that door. Some stayed, some left, but every single one told me the same thing: they wish they'd paid attention sooner. You're not just another user anymore—you're part of a quiet rebellion against the patterns that keep people trapped. Every scan you run adds a data point that helps us see toxic behavior before it destroys someone else.

Here's where you fit in: your relationship health dashboard already tracks your scans across conversations. But most people never look at the 'pattern map' hidden two taps in. That map shows you exactly which red flags keep showing up in your life—the ones your gut already knows.

Open the app today and tap the 'Pattern Map' feature. See what your history is trying to tell you. P.S. The people who check this feature are 3x more likely to spot love bombing before it spirals. Your future self will thank you.
